settings_sub: Changes apply right away, no restart needed unless marked
changed_elsewhere: The same settings were changed in another window.
restart_needed: Restart the app to use the new dashboard port
leave_body: Your edits in Settings will be lost.
f_interval_hint: Seconds between checks (1–3600). Lower is faster to detect, heavier on the network.
f_fail_hint: Consecutive failed checks needed to report an outage.
f_loss_hint: Above this the connection is reported unstable.
f_latency_hint: Above this the connection is reported unstable.
f_icmp_hint: Tells router problems apart from provider problems. May need admin rights.
f_webhook_hint: Posts every outage to a channel.
f_tg_hint: Sends the same alerts through your Telegram bot.
secret_will_remove: Will be removed when you save
sound_upload_hint: MP3 or WAV, up to 30 seconds and 10 MB
sound_uploaded: Custom sound saved — alerts will use it
f_speed_duration_hint: 5–120 seconds. Longer is more accurate on fast lines.
f_speed_upload_hint: Leave empty to skip the upload test.
f_logdir_hint: A folder inside the app folder.
update_in_progress: An update is already in progress.
update_failed_plain: The update didn't finish. Try again later.
config_error: Your config.json is damaged, so defaults are in use: {error}
sound_err_format: This file isn't a playable MP3 or WAV, or it's longer than 30 seconds.
sound_err_size: The file is empty or larger than 10 MB.
sound_preview_failed: This window couldn't play the sound — try “Play like a real alert”.
sound_play_failed: The app couldn't play the sound. Check that your computer isn't muted.
sound_check_failed: Couldn't check which sound is active
sound_reset_body: Alerts will play the default sound again.
startup_on: Internet Monitor will start with Windows
startup_off: Internet Monitor won't start with Windows
